author: Clijmart
body:
Hey Avicus Players!

We, the current BuildNBreak Members, are looking for members!
This team is looking for DTM fans, who love to learn more about the game. Since this team isn't full of hardcore pvp'ers we would love to see some new players and good ones joining our group!

We try to scrim as much as possible, and work together as a team, ofcourse.
If you feel like joining, please fill in this application format and reply it on this post.

Current Members:
Leaders:
  • Clijmart
  • Acytlon
Members:
  • MilkyWayRules
  • W0RD
  • Master_Nati
  • ElementalAssasin
  • Crimson_Aught
  • Mustafa

Requirements:
Skype
Teamspeak

Application Format:
  1. Ingame Name:
  2. Skype Name:
  3. Age:
  4. Timezone*:
  5. Past team experience:
  6. Favorite position/strategy:
  7. Strengths:
  8. Weaknessess:
  9. Why do you want to join this team:
  10. Extra info about yourself:

If possible, try to count from GMT, so GMT-3 or GMT+1 or anything like that :P
Makes it easier for us!

Hope to see some awesome people apply!

-Clijmart + Team
